properties.decision:
@ajs, dev_reflow2 hub session, 2026-09-28, starting combined position 3 ("start on step 3"), choosing between options put to him:

1. WHERE THE POINTER LIVES: `.reflow2.toml`, a small dedicated file at the repository root, committed, holding no secret. Chosen over a `[design]` table in `reflow2.toml` (today a GENERATED dependency manifest, `art:dependency-manifest`, whose header says not to edit it by hand) and over a marked line in AGENTS.md (prose nothing can check). Not inside `.reflow2/`, because every consumer project git-ignores that whole folder (tools/reflow2_init.py writes the rule).
   Shape:
   [design]
   id      = "<graph id>"
   address = "<the design's MCP address, e.g. https://api.flo2.io/g/<id>/mcp>"
   and, reserved for later, [[also]] entries with an id, an address and a role.
   The ADDRESS is stored whole rather than composed from a server and the id, because servers address a design differently (api.flo2.io's /g/<id>/mcp, a reflow2 registry's /g/<id>/); the ID is stored as well so the client can check the server's answer names the design the folder expects.

2. THE FIRST SLICE of req:a-code-folder-names-the-design-it-implements-and-its-server: the client started in the folder attaches to the design the folder implements, follows the pointer even when a local store is also present (and says so), and never opens a leftover store in its place. Other designs named in the file are shown but NOT opened; opening several in one session waits on dec:idea-a-session-holds-several-graphs.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-09-28 — a code folder's pointer is a committed `.reflow2.toml` at the repo root ([design] id + address); the first slice attaches to that one design and lists any others without opening them
properties.rationale: A dedicated file cannot be regenerated away and says one thing; the id beside the address is what lets a tool check the pointer instead of trusting it, which is the gap fact:a-users-agents-md-line-already-names-the-remote-design-2026-09-26 names in the prose form. Opening several designs at once is a larger, still-open question, and the single-design case is what closes the frozen-store defect (fact:an-agent-opened-in-a-moved-designs-folder-is-served-the-frozen-store-2026-09-27).
